name: Aerospace Engineering
summary: Three years of aerodynamics, structures, propulsion, control and space systems, taught entirely in English on TU Delft's own campus with its own wind tunnels and a full-size aircraft in the hall. Every one of its 440 places (2026-27) is allocated by selection, and the whole of the competition happens before you have IB results: you apply by 15 January and sit two tests in the spring.
